indexes.name: foto_cantiere_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX foto_cantiere_pkey ON public.foto_cantiere USING btree (id)

constraints.name: allegati_cancellato_post_cleanup
constraints.definition: CHECK (stato <> 'cancellato'::text OR removed_at IS NOT NULL AND foto_cantiere_id IS NULL AND lease_id IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL)

constraints.name: allegati_cantiere_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (cantiere_id) REFERENCES cantieri(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: allegati_coerenza
constraints.definition: CHECK (stato = 'prenotato'::text AND finalized_at IS NULL AND removed_at IS NULL AND foto_cantiere_id IS NULL OR stato = 'finalizzato'::text AND finalized_at IS NOT NULL AND removed_at IS NULL AND foto_cantiere_id IS NOT NULL OR stato = 'scaduto'::text AND finalized_at IS NULL AND removed_at IS NULL AND foto_cantiere_id IS NULL OR (stato = ANY (ARRAY['cancellazione_pending'::text, 'cancellato'::text])) AND removed_at IS NOT NULL)

constraints.name: allegati_foto_cantiere_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (foto_cantiere_id) REFERENCES foto_cantiere(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: allegati_lease
constraints.definition: CHECK (lease_id IS NULL AND lease_until IS NULL OR lease_id IS NOT NULL AND lease_until IS NOT NULL AND (stato = ANY (ARRAY['prenotato'::text, 'cancellazione_pending'::text])))

constraints.name: allegati_path
constraints.definition: CHECK (btrim(file_path) <> ''::text AND file_path !~~ '/%'::text AND strpos(file_path, '..'::text) = 0 AND file_path ~~ 'rapportini/%'::text AND length(file_path) > 11)

constraints.name: allegati_rapportino_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (rapportino_id) REFERENCES rapportini(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

indexes.name: allegati_cantiere
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX allegati_cantiere ON artecna_rapportini.allegati USING btree (cantiere_id)

indexes.name: allegati_foto
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX allegati_foto ON artecna_rapportini.allegati USING btree (foto_cantiere_id)

indexes.name: allegati_identita
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX allegati_identita ON artecna_rapportini.allegati USING btree (rapportino_id, chiave_client_allegato)

indexes.name: allegati_oggetto
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX allegati_oggetto ON artecna_rapportini.allegati USING btree (bucket, file_path)

indexes.name: allegati_pkey
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX allegati_pkey ON artecna_rapportini.allegati USING btree (id)

indexes.name: allegati_scadenza
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX allegati_scadenza ON artecna_rapportini.allegati USING btree (expires_at) WHERE (stato = 'prenotato'::text)

metadata.argomenti_identita: p_id uuid, p_rapportino uuid, p_cantiere uuid, p_data date
metadata.argomenti_con_default: p_id uuid, p_rapportino uuid, p_cantiere uuid, p_data date

metadata.argomenti_identita: p_sessione text, p_allegato_id uuid, p_lease_id uuid
metadata.argomenti_con_default: p_sessione text, p_allegato_id uuid, p_lease_id uuid
